item.title: Murderer scheduled for execution next week
item.description: Two Cobb County women lost their lives because of a few thousand dollars, and soon the man convicted of killing them and taking their money is scheduled to meet his own end. The post Murderer scheduled for execution next week appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Family YMCA of Greater Augusta names new vice president ahead of North Augusta expansion
item.description: The Family YMCA of Greater Augusta has appointed Melanie Quick as its new vice president of memberships and mission advancement, the organization announced Tuesday. item.title: Melissa Brocato named interim athletic director at Augusta University
item.description: Augusta University has named Melissa Brocato interim athletic director following the resignation of Ryan Erlacher on Dec. 8. The post Melissa Brocato named interim athletic director at Augusta University appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Evans High runner recognized, Harlem High project advances at CCBOE regular session
item.description: The Columbia County Board of Education concluded its final meeting of 2025 with student recognition, a major facility planning vote and a lengthy public participation period during its Dec. 9 regular session. item.title: Grovetown recognizes councilmembers Ceretta Smith and Sylvia Martin
item.description: Grovetown City Council took time to honor two of its members, Ceretta Smith and Sylvia Martin, during its meeting Monday night, as the meeting was the last for both of them as councilmembers. item.title: Fort Gordon hospital downgrade still possible, DHA calls concerns ‘premature’
item.description: Plans to downgrade the military hospital at Fort Gordon remain a real possibility, but the Defense Health Agency says questions about reductions are premature. item.title: Armed robbery suspect at large after incident at Tobacco Road Dollar General
item.description: The Richmond County Sheriff’s Office is seeking the public’s help in identifying and locating a female suspect wanted in connection with an armed robbery that occurred Sunday at the Dollar General store on the 2400 block of Tobacco Road in Hephzibah. item.title: Coliseum Authority gets final update for arena in 2025
